frozen_success.recognition: For each schedule separately, at least 2 of 3 independently restored parent seed groups detect each of three true changes within 16 stream episodes after boundary. Timing windows [49..64], [97..112], [145..160].
frozen_success.false_alarms: Each seed/schedule <=3 alarms outside detection windows. Duplicate alarms in the same detection window are counted as false alarms after the first matching alarm.
frozen_success.reward: For each schedule separately, pooled held decision reward at checkpoints64,112,160 >= no_reset+0.05 and >= both periodic32 and fully fitted trailing64 MLE. All arms use same public actions/evidence where compatible.
frozen_success.retention: For each schedule, native detector final familiar invariant reward at count192 >=0.8 (288 held episodes).
frozen_success.custody: Exact parent 448 witness prefix preserved in all 640-episode continuations; independent monitor parity; matched-source action/consequence order; no protected first-use; two-OS identical semantic scores and final checkpoint bytes; mandatory full final regression exact sealed candidate tree.
